findings.title: Default proto codec now rejects APIv1-only message types
findings.why_it_matters: Any application whose request/response types implement only the APIv1 interface (Reset/String/ProtoMessage, e.g. code from protoc-gen-go < v1.4 or other legacy generators) used to work with gRPC's default codec, because github.com/golang/protobuf's proto.Message is protoiface.MessageV1 and its Marshal/Unmarshal adapted such types to APIv2 internally. After switching the import to google.golang.org/protobuf/proto, the type assertion `v.(proto.Message)` now requires the APIv2 ProtoReflect() method, so every RPC using such types fails at runtime with "failed to marshal, message is %T, want proto.Message" (surfaced as codes.Internal). This is a silent, compile-clean break of the default wire codec's accepted input, contradicting the migration's stated no-behavior-change intent. Accepting both shapes and adapting V1 via protoadapt.MessageV2Of restores the old contract.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a helper `func messageV2Of(v any) proto.Message { switch v := v.(type) { case protoadapt.MessageV2: return v; case protoadapt.MessageV1: return protoadapt.MessageV2Of(v) }; return nil }` (check MessageV2 first so dual-API generated types are not wrapped) and use it in both codec.Marshal and codec.Unmarshal, returning the existing 'want proto.Message' error only when it returns nil. Add a codec test using a V1-only message type.
evidence: encoding/proto/proto.go:41 -- vv, ok := v.(proto.Message)   (proto now = google.golang.org/protobuf/proto; Message = protoreflect.ProtoMessage)
encoding/proto/proto.go:49 -- vv, ok := v.(proto.Message)   (same narrowing on Unmarshal)
base 5051eeae encoding/proto/proto.go imported "github.com/golang/protobuf/proto"; github.com/golang/protobuf@v1.5.3/proto/proto.go:50 -- type Message = protoiface.MessageV1
WithDetails in the same diff already acknowledges V1-only inputs by calling protoadapt.MessageV2Of(detail) (internal/status/status.go:141), but the codec does not

findings.title: Status.Details returns V2 wrappers instead of original V1 types
findings.why_it_matters: Callers commonly do `for _, d := range st.Details() { if info, ok := d.(*mypb.ErrorInfo); ok {...} }`. Previously Details() used ptypes.DynamicAny, whose Empty() returns proto.MessageV1(mt.New().Interface()), unwrapping legacy (APIv1-only) registered types back to their concrete Go type. Now any.UnmarshalNew() returns mt.New().Interface(), which for legacy types is an internal *impl.messageIfaceWrapper, so those type assertions silently fail and detail handling is skipped (no error is reported). Generated APIv2 types are unaffected, but WithDetails explicitly still accepts V1-only messages, so a round-trip WithDetails -> Details no longer returns the type that was passed in. Wrapping the result with protoadapt.MessageV1Of restores the old returned type for both legacy and modern messages.
findings.suggested_fix: In Details(), append `protoadapt.MessageV1Of(detail)` instead of `detail` (MessageV1Of unwraps legacy wrappers and returns dual-API generated messages unchanged), and add a test that round-trips a V1-only detail message through WithDetails/Details and type-asserts the original type.
evidence: internal/status/status.go:163 -- details = append(details, detail)   (detail from any.UnmarshalNew(), a protoreflect.ProtoMessage)
github.com/golang/protobuf@v1.5.3/ptypes/any.go:77 -- return proto.MessageV1(mt.New().Interface()), nil   (old path unwrapped to the V1 concrete type)

google.golang.org/protobuf@v1.32.0/internal/impl/message_reflect_gen.go:140-143 -- Interface() returns the unwrapped value only if it implements protoreflect.ProtoMessage; otherwise returns the iface wrapper
internal/status/status.go:134 -- func (s *Status) WithDetails(details ...protoadapt.MessageV1) (*Status, error)  (V1-only inputs still accepted)

residual_risks: Status.Details() error text for undecodable details changed (e.g. empty type URL: was `message type url "" is invalid`, now `proto: invalid empty type URL`); status/status_test.go was updated to match, confirming the observable change. Callers matching on error strings (Hyrum's Law) would break; low impact.

balancer/rls/config.go:310 convertDuration now uses AsDuration()+CheckValid(); ptypes.Duration also rejected values overflowing time.Duration (>~292 years). RLS route lookup configs with such huge max_age/stale_age/lookup_service_timeout were previously rejected and are now accepted with a saturated value; mostly masked by the 5-minute maxMaxAge clamp.

Root go.mod still requires github.com/golang/protobuf (not in changed files); no public exported signature other than WithDetails changed, and WithDetails is type-identical (protoadapt.MessageV1 = protoiface.MessageV1 = golang/protobuf proto.Message). Exported-symbol scan was grep-based over the diff.
testing_gaps: No test exercises the default codec or Status.WithDetails/Details with a message type implementing only the APIv1 interface, which is exactly the compatibility surface this migration changes.
